garrison.note: The town's Remnant garrison (M15): one alarm for every trooper here. Klaxon at the watchtower. disengage_dist is from the nearest trooper, who will not chase past its chase_leash (gate 30 m, barracks 55 m), so running out into the desert does lose them.

locals.note: The port's own people. They mind their business until you hurt one; then every local in town fights you (merchants and the fence from behind their counters, never leaving the stall). Same alarm rules as the garrison, its own alarm: shooting a local does not call the Remnant, and the other way round.

club.note: Issue #261: the cantina is a chill jazz club (ClubDressing 'jazz'): plank floor and a checker floor round the stage, panelled walls under velvet drapes, booths and candlelit tables, warm and blue stage spots, a neon sign over the bar. The band (markers band_*, each with the instrument in front of them: 'prop') plays at 'bpm'; 'dim' turns the house lights down; kill one and the music stops until the next visit. Patrons (soldier local_patron) stand at the tables and walk the room with a drink.
